title: Private Tour: Romantic Niagara Falls Helicopter Flight
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy an unforgettable experience with your loved one on this romantic Niagara Falls helicopter tour. Sip sparkling wine and take in the sights of the majestic falls, historical landmarks and Niagara's renowned wine country on a private 25-minute helicopter flight. Love is in the air!
